# Synthetic test fixture — nothing here is real

Every document, publisher, scheme name, section number, rate, fee, margin and
benchmark in this directory is **invented for testing only**. None of it is a
real government scheme, a real interest rate, a real licence fee, or a real
industry benchmark. Do not cite it, quote it, or treat any figure in it as a
fact about an actual Indian credit scheme.

Every document's `publisher` field says so explicitly ("Fictional Rural Credit
Bureau (synthetic test fixture — not a real institution)"), every `document_id`
and `scheme` slug is prefixed `test-`, and every chunk's text says "synthetic
test fixture" somewhere in it — on purpose, so nobody downstream can mistake a
test constant for a sourced fact (CLAUDE.md §3.5, §30).

Regenerated by a one-off script (not committed; see `docs/phase-5.md` for the
real ETL, `scripts/build_knowledge_corpus.py` / `scripts/build_parameter_registry.py`,
which produce the real `data/knowledge/` artifacts from operator-supplied
documents — this directory is unrelated to that pipeline's output).

## Layout

- `documents.jsonl` — 10 `DocumentRecord` rows.
- `chunks.jsonl` — 12 `DocumentChunk` rows (plain JSONL; the real corpus under
  `data/knowledge/` uses `chunks.jsonl.gz` — the loader accepts either).
- `parameters.csv` — 15 rows: 12 valid `SourcedParameter` rows plus 3
  deliberately broken ones, each exercising one loader-level rejection:
  - `test-quote-mismatch-guideline:moratorium_months:1` — a self-consistent
    row whose `evidence_quote` does **not** occur verbatim in the chunk it
    cites (`parameters_rejected_unverified_quote`).
  - `test-national-credit-guideline:subsidy_pct:99` — cites a `chunk_id` that
    does not exist in `chunks.jsonl` (`parameters_rejected_unknown_chunk`).
  - `test-bihar-state-guideline:interest_rate_pct:99` — an unparseable `unit`
    column (`parse_errors`).
- `manifest.json` — corpus build metadata (`corpus_manifest_version` /
  `corpus_built_at` in `KnowledgeAcquisitionReport`).

## What the 12 valid rows are for

| scheme / document | exercises |
|---|---|
| `test-rural-udyog-yojana` (national doc + Bihar-state doc, same scheme) | national-fallback vs. state-specific precedence; a state-level `interest_rate_pct` beats the national one for a Bihar query |
| `test-bihar-state-guideline`'s `promoter_margin_pct` | the unit trap — resolves, but must stay **unbound** from `declared_margin_requirement` (RATIO vs. the field's INR) |
| `test-bihar-licence-schedule` | a statutory fee — the `LICENCE_FEE_INR` -> `CostLine(kind=LICENCE)` binding path |
| `test-industry-grocery-benchmark` | an `INDUSTRY_BODY`-tier sector benchmark (`inventory_days`) resolving cleanly; **no** `gross_margin_pct` exists anywhere in this corpus on purpose, so that parameter always resolves `NO_EVIDENCE` |
| `test-conflict-scheme` (two docs, same tier/specificity/date, different rates) | `CONFLICTING` |
| `test-stale-scheme` (expired `effective_to`) | `STALE_ONLY` |
| `test-conditional-scheme` (a stated condition) | `CONDITIONS_UNRESOLVED` |
| `test-secondary-only-scheme` (`SECONDARY` tier) | tier-floor rejection -> `NO_EVIDENCE` |
